# Interaction Pattern Library — Guidance Index
# 交互模式库 — 指南索引

The guidance for this template is split by major section so consumers can load
one part at a time. Read the file matching the section you are currently
authoring — never all three at once.
此模板的指南按主要章节拆分，以便使用者一次只加载一部分。阅读与你当前正在编写的
章节相匹配的文件 — 绝不要一次读完三个。

| Template Section | Guidance File |
|------------------|---------------|
| Standard Control Patterns (Button variants, Toggle, Slider, Dropdown / Select, List Item, Grid Item, Modal Dialog, Confirmation Dialog, Toast / Notification, Tooltip, Progress Bar, Input Field, Tab Bar, Scroll Container) | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-standard-controls.md` |
| Game-Specific UI Patterns (Inventory Slot, Ability / Skill Icon, Health / Resource Bar, Dialogue Box, Context Action Prompt, Damage Number) | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-game-specific.md` |
| Navigation Patterns + Feedback and Loading Patterns (Screen Push / Pop / Replace, Focus Management, Escape / Cancel, Loading State, Empty State, Error State) | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-navigation-feedback.md` |

| 模板章节 | 指南文件 |
|------------------|---------------|
| 标准控件模式（按钮变体、开关、滑块、下拉 / 选择、列表项、网格项、模态对话框、确认对话框、Toast / 通知、工具提示、进度条、输入框、标签栏、滚动容器） | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-standard-controls.md` |
| 游戏专属 UI 模式（库存槽位、技能 / 技能图标、生命 / 资源条、对话框、情境操作提示、伤害数字） | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-game-specific.md` |
| 导航模式 + 反馈与加载模式（屏幕推入 / 弹出 / 替换、焦点管理、Esc / 取消、加载状态、空状态、错误状态） | `.claude/docs/templates/guidance/interaction-pattern-library-guide-navigation-feedback.md` |

Each guidance file contains the full reference specification for its patterns —
When to Use / When NOT to Use rationale, complete state tables with timing and
audio values, accessibility requirements, and engine implementation notes. Use
them as the worked-example source when filling the corresponding skeleton stubs
in the template. The Pattern Catalog Index, Animation Standards, Sound
Standards, and Open Questions sections remain in the template itself.
每个指南文件都包含其模式的完整参考规格 —
何时使用 / 何时不使用的理由、含时序与音频值的完整状态表、无障碍要求，以及引擎实现说明。
在填写模板中对应的骨架占位时，将它们作为完整示例来源。模式目录索引、动画标准、
声音标准和待决问题章节仍保留在模板本身中。
